title: fix(studio): a read-only package's flow Enabled switch is drawn muted with a lock

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 自动化页里,只读(代码)包的流程「启用」开关不再画成绿色的可操作开关,改为灰色轨道加一把锁;开/关的位置与文字照旧如实显示。
- 为什么改:HotCRM 18.2.0 浏览器走查(hotcrm#2320 Studio S10)发现只读包的开关绿着,看起来能点,其实点不动。
- 风险与回滚:只改这一个开关的样式类与一个图标;可写包外观和行为不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`(`flowSwitchEl` 里的 `track` 与 `Lock`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyFlowSwitch-27356.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Row 21 of #27356 (hotcrm#2320, Studio report finding S10): "A read-only package's flow Enabled switch is drawn on and green, like a live control."

In the Automations pillar's flow header (`flowSwitchEl` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`), on a read-only package:

- The track is muted: `bg-muted-foreground/60` when the flow is on, `bg-muted-foreground/25` when it is off, instead of `bg-emerald-500` / `bg-muted-foreground/40`.
- A lock icon (`Lock`, `aria-hidden`) sits between the track and the word.
- The button drops its hover fill and the `disabled:opacity-50` fade, and reads in `text-muted-foreground`, so the lock and the word stay legible.
- Unchanged: the thumb position, the word (Enabled / Disabled), `aria-checked`, `disabled`, and the read-only reason on the wrapper (objectui#12303).

A writable package's switch is unchanged: green track when on, hover fill, operable.

## Why

The switch was already disabled on a read-only package (objectui#11124), but a disabled switch drawn green at half opacity still reads as a live control that is on. The muted track plus the lock says "on, and locked" in the same place the read-only chip already says why.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyFlowSwitch-27356.test.tsx` (4 tests, the real `AutomationsPillar` and the registered `FlowPreview`, harness copied from the objectui#11124 file):

- Read-only, enabled flow: disabled, `aria-checked="true"`, the track has no `bg-emerald-500` and carries the muted on-class, the thumb is at on, a hidden lock is present, no hover fill, and a click saves nothing.
- Read-only, disabled flow: `aria-checked="false"`, the fainter track, the thumb at off, the lock.
- CONTROL writable, enabled flow: green track, no lock, a click saves `status: 'obsolete'`.
- CONTROL writable, disabled flow: the grey track it always had, no lock.

Restored: blob after restore = blob at HEAD = `112c2439faa1`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>
